metadata.timings: No performance claims. Evaluation counts are recorded; wall times are deliberately not compared.
metadata.search: Union of 257 logarithmic points [1e-8,32] and 257 linear points [0,8], endpoint 0; bounded refinement of grid local minima plus global sampled best, xatol=1e-13, maxiter=200. Frequency normalized by specified tau.
metadata.limitations: Numerical local search is not globally certified by sampling. Exact case-specific identities supply reference radii. Raw discriminant failures are retained, never clipped.
